decided: With the sign-off setting absent, nothing waits for the user to sign off; a project chooses to sign off at every change's archive, or once at the end of a program.
alternatives: sign off at every change's archive by default
tie how often the user signs off to the regime, as R-adf-2 first said
why: R-adf-1 says every setting defaults to today's behaviour, and today the user signs off only by choosing to run the archive; the user asked for how often to be a choice of its own.
